systems.country_label: Open Data - Assemblée Nationale de Madagascar
systems.platform: read-only REST API with JSON and CSV exports
systems.owner: Assemblée nationale de Madagascar (supported by EISA)

note: A parliament's own open data page and API (five datasets, Licence Ouverte v2.0); not a national government portal and tied to no open data policy, so a systems entry only.
A statistics office's gated microdata platform is class other; the page states nothing on an open data policy or a government open data portal.

systems.owner: not named; the page names no ministry or agency

note: The page names no operating institution, so it is not established as a government portal, and it ties the portal to no open data policy, names no publishing body and gives no dataset count.

facts.fact: The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025 round) that Madagascar has no open data portal; the line gives no date, so the survey round's year is used.

note: ODIN scores what the statistics office publishes and how openly; it states no open data policy or government portal.
